tip: Break large assignments into smaller tasks so they feel easier to complete.
Review your notes within 24 hours of class to improve long-term retention.
Use the Pomodoro technique: 25 minutes of focused work followed by a 5-minute break.
Study the hardest subject first while your focus is sharpest.
Silence notifications during study blocks to protect your deep work time.
Rewrite key concepts in your own words rather than re-reading passively.
Set a specific goal for each study session, not just a time limit.
Use spaced repetition: review material at increasing intervals to lock it in.
